# For each character at position i:
#   expected[i] == input[i] XOR edx
#   then edx = edx + input[i]
#

#   input[i] = expected[i] XOR edx
#   then edx = edx + input[i]

                  0xd4, 0x72, 0xb6, 0xd4, 0x74, 0xb7, 0xe8, 0x71, 0x49, 0xc5, 
                  0x16, 0x25])

edx = 0x66  # 'f'
result = []

for i in range(22):
    # expected[i] == input[i] XOR edx
    # So input[i] = expected[i] XOR edx
    input_char = expected[i] ^ edx
    result.append(input_char)
    # Then edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xFFFFFFFF  (32-bit)
    edx = (edx + input_char) & 0xFFFFFFFF

# Convert to string
decoded = ''.join(chr(c) for c in result)
print(f"Decoded input: {decoded}")
print(f"Bytes: {result}")
